title: Approval of Resolution for Energy Cost Adjustment Expenditures. The
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Resolution for Energy Cost Adjustment Expenditures. The
  proposed Resolution approves expenditures for a 12-Month Period
  Commencing October 1, 2026.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Section
  15060(c)(3).
summary: Resolution approving Energy Cost Adjustment Expenditures for 12-month period commencing October 1, 2026.

flag.reason: Electric rate pass-through adjustment starting Oct 1.
